name: Create content property for comment
description: Create content property for comment Creates a new content property for a comment. POST /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties
context:
POST /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties
Creates a new content property for a comment. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to update the comment.
Required: comment-id (path) — The ID of the comment to create a property for.; body (body) — The content property to be created

name: Delete content property for comment by id
description: Delete content property for comment by id Deletes a content property for a comment by its id. DELETE /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties/{property-id}

name: Get content properties for comment
description: Get content properties for comment Retrieves Content Properties attached to a specified comment. GET /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties
context:
GET /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties
Retrieves Content Properties attached to a specified comment. **[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**: Permission to view the comment.
Required: comment-id (path) — The ID of the comment for which content properties should be returned.
Optional: key (query) — Filters the response to return a specific content property with matching key (case sensitive).; sort (query) — Used to sort the result by a particular field.; cursor (query) — Used for pagination, this opaque cursor will be returned in the `next` URL in the `Link` response header. Use the relative URL in the `Link` header to retrieve the `next` set of results.; limit (query) — Maximum number of attachments per result to return. If more results exist, use the `Link` header to retrieve a relative URL that will return the next set of results.

name: Get content property for comment by id
description: Get content property for comment by id Retrieves a specific Content Property by ID that is attached to a specified comment. GET /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties/{property-id}

name: Update content property for comment by id
description: Update content property for comment by id Update a content property for a comment by its id. PUT /wiki/api/v2/comments/{comment-id}/properties/{property-id}
